figures.finding: No agreement or minimum for a actor is set in the US Minor Outlying Islands, which have no permanent inhabitants; filming on the island refuges is allowed only by a federal permit (50 CFR 27.71, under 43 CFR part 5), and the US federal minimum wage and overtime rules (FLSA ss. 206-207) reach work on Wake Island and Johnston Island, not on the other islands.

Result: Results are Wikipedia and its mirrors (none of the islands has known permanent residents; visitors are temporary staff; Palmyra the only incorporated territory) and unreliable AI-generated pages. Used only as leads to the Interior Department's own pages below.

Result: Read: Palmyra is 'a National Wildlife Refuge administered by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Services in the Department of Interior', the only incorporated territory; Wake 'has had no indigenous inhabitants', 'approximately 302 inhabitants' (missile-defence personnel; administration funded by the Ballistic Missile Defense Organization), US court jurisdiction in Honolulu (48 U.S.C. 644a); Midway is a national wildlife refuge. No broadcaster, theatre, fund or screen body: the islands are federal refuges and military sites under US law.
tried.official-register: US Code via Cornell LII (secondary, quoting the Code): 29 U.S.C. 213(f) and 206(a)(1) (files /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/03f7067b-6e1c-5cca-95b5-33cc49c92f8f/scratchpad/l4t/files/m13/us-29usc213.html sha256 8a75d2ff764cee61645182cf8fd4e4da154480615079a3221f14feb5f9d94134, us-29usc206.html sha256 a895d735a52d70584d8c2f9c93fbc77d17946c1016905b136bc6b455babf8048), read for which of the islands US labour law reaches (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: Read: the FLSA's wage and hour sections 'shall not apply with respect to any employee whose services during the workweek are performed in a workplace within a foreign country or within territory under the jurisdiction of the United States other than ... Guam; Wake Island; Eniwetok Atoll; Kwajalein Atoll; and Johnston Island': so the USD 7.25 federal floor reaches Wake and Johnston, and not Baker, Howland, Jarvis, Kingman, Midway, Palmyra or Navassa. No stage or screen pay instrument applies to any of them; no incentive or fund exists in law for them.
